brand.name: Kabtn
landing.title: Kabtn — the bot for Arabic Discord gaming servers
landing.tagline: A voice assistant that speaks your dialect, automatic voice and text protection, and activity stats with a welcome image — all under Kabtn's command
landing.cta.invite: Add the bot to your server
landing.feature.voice.title: Smart voice assistant
landing.feature.voice.body: Say the wake word and it answers in your dialect — Gulf, Syrian, Egyptian or MSA — and runs admin commands like voice-kicking a member, with an optional comedic personality
landing.feature.protection.title: Protection
landing.feature.protection.body: Voice profanity moderation with a warning then a kick on repeat offenses, plus automatic text protection against scam and suspicious links
landing.feature.activity.title: Stats & welcome
landing.feature.activity.body: An activity dashboard (messages and voice minutes) and an auto-generated welcome image for every new member who joins
landing.premium.title: Premium — coming soon
landing.premium.body: Higher daily limits for listening and AI questions
